patch_description: The current candidate uses ry_even/ry_odd (2 params) plus a single zz_shared and single rz_shared per block (4 unique params/block, 26 total), but converges slowly (420 steps) despite perfect accuracy. The earlier 20-param seed (fully shared RY, shared RZ pre-entangler, single ZZ, alternating RZ post) converged much faster (60 steps) with even lower loss. I combine the best of both: fully shared RY (1 param) for maximal parameter economy, split the entangling ZZ ring into two alternating parameters (zz_even/zz_odd) to enrich entanglement expressivity per the recommendation, and use a single shared final RZ. This gives 1 (RY) + 2 (ZZ alternating) + 1 (RZ) = 4 unique params per block × 6 = 24 + 2 readout = 26 total params (same param count as current), but the richer/alternating ZZ entangling pattern combined with fully-shared RY should improve convergence speed and lower validation/test loss, mirroring the fast-converging seed's structure while adding slightly more entangling expressivity.
